Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the notification for the Bihar School Library Eligibility Test BSLET Examination 2026. The online application process for Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Online Form 2026 has started on 01 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 October 2026
  • Last Date : 21 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 19 November 2026 to 10 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, BC : Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 760/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
